population: 3% ID-sampled 2023-01-01 to 2023-07-31 narratives in fixed taxonomy window, after required-field/ID checks
interpretation: Duplicate/unsupported cases are assigned to review, not silently removed from workload. This is a hypothetical gate on a sample, not measured institution productivity.
limitations: Wilson bounds used during threshold search are descriptive, not post-selection guarantees.
Rare-class accepted volumes can be too small for reliable quality claims.
